name: security

findings.message: Test part (c) of #1753/SPEC-4 evals an awk-extracted code fragment from runner.sh (`eval "$_spec4_rc_onward"`) without sanitizing the extracted content: if runner.sh is tampered, arbitrary code executes during the CI test suite run; subshell isolation (`( _spec4_runtime )`) limits parent-shell variable leakage but does not prevent filesystem writes or arbitrary command execution within the subshell.

The new `error()` call passes `${_ZB_MAP_UNFINISHED:-…}` to `echo -e`; the `outcome` substring of `_ZB_MAP_UNFINISHED` is jq-extracted from plugin-written result files and is sanitized only for CR/LF — backslash escape sequences (e.g. ANSI terminal control codes) in a plugin-supplied outcome value are interpreted by `echo -e`, enabling log injection or terminal manipulation via stderr.

reason: the security lens found no high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
